description: §19.16.2 — a braced `match` STATEMENT arm block is a defer site: the deferred statement registers against the ARM block and runs when the arm exits, before the statement after the match. f(.A) writes ma, exits the arm (MA), then end; f(.B) takes the arm without a defer: trace = "ma;MA;end;mb;end;".
rationale: §19.16.2 Registration: the enclosing block of a `defer` is the innermost statement list that contains it, and the list names "a braced match arm block". Exit: every deferred body registered in that block runs when control leaves it. (The native front-end does not support this site yet — it carries statement-position match arms as text and rejects the `defer` with E-DEFER-UNSUPPORTED-SITE; a documented §19.16.8 divergence pinned by compiler/tests/unit/defer-outside-function-bodies.test.js. The runner exercises impl#1's default front-end.)
